name: EMBO Scientific Exchange Grant
amount: Travel and subsistence for the fellow (rate depends on destination); no dependants, visa costs, bench fees or overheads
other_rules: At least 1 year of graduate research experience
exchange must be between an EMBC member state or cooperation partner (e.g. India) and another country, not within one country
cannot visit former supervisors or colleagues, a previously visited lab, or extend an existing collaboration
must return to the home lab for at least 6 months afterwards
notes: Visits of 1 week to 3 months. Apply at least 30 days (ideally 3 months) before the visit; decisions take 3-4 months. Needs two references and written acceptance from the host. Details from a 2025 summary; confirm current rules on embo.org.

documents.name: Host acceptance letter
documents.notes: Written acceptance from the receiving institute
